counts.plot(marker='o', color='#7dd3fc', title='Reported strikes by year — partial 1990 and 2002')
plt.xlabel('Year'); plt.ylabel('Reports'); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

points.title: How does reported wildlife size vary by time of day?

# analet: How does reported wildlife size vary by time of day?

points.title: How do seasonal patterns differ for common identified species?
points.code:
# analet: How do seasonal patterns differ for common identified species?
species = df.loc[~df['Wildlife Species'].str.contains('Unknown', case=False), 'Wildlife Species'].value_counts().head(4).index
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(11,6), sharex=True)
for ax, name in zip(axes.flat, species):
    df.loc[df['Wildlife Species'].eq(name)].groupby(df['Flight Date'].dt.month).size().reindex(range(1,13),fill_value=0).plot(ax=ax, marker='o', color='#c4b5fd')
    ax.set_title(name); ax.set_xlabel('Month'); ax.set_ylabel('Reports')
fig.suptitle('Seasonality within the historical sample'); fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

points.title: What is the distribution of strictly positive recorded total costs?

# analet: What is the distribution of strictly positive recorded total costs?
positive = df.loc[df['Cost Total $'].gt(0), 'Cost Total $']

plt.hist(np.log10(positive), bins=30, color='#fbbf24', edgecolor='#292524')
